content: app.enableShutdownHooks() (already wired in main.ts) activates onModuleDestroy/beforeApplicationShutdown/onApplicationShutdown lifecycle hooks on SIGTERM/SIGINT. Implement OnApplicationShutdown on the ingest service to flush the pending stream_cursor value synchronously-awaited before the hook resolves; note app.close() does not kill the process by itself if intervals/long-lived streams are still open -- the SSE fetch/ReadableStream loop must observe a shutdown flag and break, or the process hangs post-signal.
